definitions.explanation: Making information publicly known; an official statement or release.
Showing or presenting work to an audience, such as research findings or artistic performances.

examples.japanese: {新製品|しんせいひん}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
{研究|けんきゅう}{結果|けっか}を{学会|がっかい}で{発表|はっぴょう}する。
examples.english: I will present my research results at the conference.

examples.japanese: {選挙|せんきょ}{結果|けっか}の{発表|はっぴょう}を{待|ま}っている。
examples.english: I'm waiting for the announcement of the election results.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}のピアノの{発表|はっぴょう}{会|かい}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to my child's piano recital.
examples.notes: {発表|はっぴょう}{会|かい} = recital, presentation event

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}のゼミで{論文|ろんぶん}の{発表|はっぴょう}をしなければならない。
examples.english: I have to give a paper presentation at next week's seminar.

examples.japanese: {文化祭|ぶんかさい}でダンスの{発表|はっぴょう}をした。
examples.english: I gave a dance performance at the school festival.

notes:
USAGE: {発表|はっぴょう} covers both official announcements (news, results) and academic/artistic presentations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{発表|はっぴょう}する (to announce, to present)
・{発表|はっぴょう}によると (according to the announcement)
・{発表|はっぴょう}{会|かい} (presentation, recital)
・{発表|はっぴょう}を{行|おこな}う (to make an announcement)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{発表|はっぴょう}{会|かい} (presentation meeting, recital)
・{記者|きしゃ}{発表|はっぴょう} (press release)
・{研究|けんきゅう}{発表|はっぴょう} (research presentation)
・{学会|がっかい}{発表|はっぴょう} (conference presentation)
・{公式|こうしき}{発表|はっぴょう} (official announcement)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{公表|こうひょう} - public disclosure (formal)
・{発売|はつばい} - release for sale
・{報告|ほうこく} - report
